faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our online classes, tutors, timings, and payments.

questions.q: Can I choose class timing at my own convenience?
questions.a: Yes, you can. Our tutors are available 24/7 so you can pick any time as per your convenience across all global time zones (UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Europe & worldwide).

questions.q: Do you have female tutors as well?
questions.a: Yes, we have certified female Quran tutors (Qariahs and Hafizas) who are equally qualified and specialized for sisters and young girls.

questions.q: What is the duration of each class?
questions.a: Each class lasts about 30 to 35 minutes of focused instruction. The duration may be longer for some lessons depending on the topics covered.

questions.q: Can I change class timing once I pick up the time?
questions.a: Yes, we understand routines can change. You can request a timing adjustment by contacting your coordinator in advance.

questions.q: What if I need to change my class timing for some reason or miss a class?
questions.a: In this case, simply message us on WhatsApp or send an email asking to adjust the timing or arrange a makeup class.

questions.q: Do you have family & sibling discounts?
questions.a: Yes, there is a special discount for two or more students enrolling from the same family.
We accept secure payment through any Debit/Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard, Amex) or direct bank transfer in your local currency ($ USD, £ GBP, A$ AUD, C$ CAD, € EUR).
You may cancel or pause your subscription at any time with no long-term contracts and no cancellation fees.

questions.q: Do I need a physical copy of The Quran?
questions.a: No. We provide all the course materials such as Digital Quran, Noorani Qaida, and Tajweed exercises. The tutor highlights the passage/line being recited live on the screen so you can follow along seamlessly.
